entities.name: Grosjean
entities.description: Grosjean was later given a one-race ban for causing the collision, becoming the first driver in eighteen years to be banned from racing.

entities.name: Maldonado
entities.description: Maldonado retired shortly after the restart with a broken front wing after making contact with Timo Glock.

entities.name: Timo Glock
entities.description: Timo Glock was involved in a collision with Maldonado.

entities.name: Narain Karthikeyan
entities.description: Narain Karthikeyan spun off at Stavelot mid-way through the race when his wheel came loose.

entities.name: Button
entities.description: Button controlled the race from the front and was unchallenged throughout.

entities.name: Sebastian Vettel
entities.description: Sebastian Vettel clawed his way up to second from tenth on the grid.

entities.name: Belgium
entities.description: The race took place at the Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps in Belgium.
